docs.title: USP Secure Entry Server ® 5.18.0.2
docs.text:
SES 5.18.0.2 consists of the following components:

  • SES Web GUI 5.18.0.1
  • HTTP Secure Proxy (HSP) 4.27.0.5
  • Secure Login Service (SLS) 5.20.0.5
  • Identity Manager (IDM) 2.3.0.1
  • Shared Appliance Base (SAB) 1.17.6

docs.title: Platform Compatibility
docs.text:
This release is compatible with the following hardware platforms:

  • Dell PowerEdge R660
  • Dell PowerEdge R650
  • Dell PowerEdge R640

docs.title: Bugfixes
docs.text: ID Description #292510 Fixed permission problem with CheckMK agent script after an appliance reboot.

docs.title: Checkmk monitoring support
docs.text: Checkmk is a versatile, scalable and powerful monitoring solution. The SES Appliance now includes a built‑in Checkmk SSH agent, enabling seamless integration with Checkmk monitoring environments. Configuring the SES appliance to make it available for Checkmk is as simple as setting an SSH public key for the Checkmk agent user. The new functionality is available under “System / Monitoring”.

docs.title: OWASP CRS Update
docs.text: The OWASP CRS ruleset has been upgraded to 3.3.8 to address recent issues and vulnerabilities.

docs.title: SES Appliance Base Checkmk Support
docs.text: Support for monitoring with Checkmk agents has been added. (5.18.0.0)

docs.title: SES GUI Checkmk Config Support
docs.text: The CheckMK agent SSH public key can now be configured in the monitoring section. (5.18.0.0)

docs.title: SES Appliance Base Factory reset removed
docs.text: The “factory reset” and “restore last version” options were removed from the GRUB menu. (5.18.0.1)

docs.title: SES Appliance Base Updated Tomcat
docs.text: Updated Tomcat to 9.0.116 for SES GUI, SLS and IDM to address various vulnerabilities. (5.18.0.1)

docs.title: SES Appliance Base Removed free MaxMind GeoIP update license
docs.text: Removed free MaxMind GeoIP database updates due to licensing change. (5.18.0.1)

docs.title: SES Appliance Base Column separator in CheckMK config fixes
docs.text: CheckMK: Fix column separator in plugin http_monitor.py and update agent to 2.4.0p22+ (CVE–2025–6499) (5.18.0.1)

docs.title: SES GUI User Management LDAP AD sync failed fixed
docs.text: SES User Management LDAP AD sync failed if sAMAccountName started with a number. (5.18.0.1)

docs.title: SES ACCESS CSP upgrade issues.
docs.text: When updating from 5.16 to 5.18, a partially incorrect CSP would be configured by default for SLS. (5.18.0.1)

docs.title: SES WAF Updates
docs.text: Updated openssl to v3.0.20. (5.18.0.1)

docs.title: SES GUI OWASP CRS 3.3.8
docs.text: Support for OWASP CRS 3.3.8 has been added. (5.18.0.0)

docs.title: SES GUI SLS CSP Validation
docs.text: The GUI now performs some basic validation of the SLS content security policy. (5.18.0.0)

docs.title: SES GUI ACME screen improvement
docs.text: The drop-down list of private keys in the ACME screen is now sorted alphabetically. (5.18.0.0)

docs.title: SES WAF Updates
docs.text: Updated httpd to v2.4.66, openssl to v3.0.19 and 3rd party libraries. (5.18.0.0)

docs.title: SES Appliance Based
docs.text: Fixed permission problem with CheckMK agent script after an appliance reboot. (5.18.0.2)

docs.title: SES ACCESS documentation fixes
docs.text: A build issue with the SLS scripting guide documentation has been fixed which resulted in some scripting prefixes like “oidc_rp” not having been included previously. (5.18.0.0)

docs.title: SES ACCESS Session-Clean up issue
docs.text: Fixed minor issue with exception being logged during session clean-up under certain circumstances involving the hard final timeout and concurrent request processing. (5.18.0.0)

docs.title: SES ACCESS CSP QR Code issue fixed
docs.text: Fixed issue with Google Authenticator QR code not being rendered due to default Content Security Policy. (5.18.0.0)
